answer: Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 138 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Because the timber reference is updated at each sonnet checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the relic audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 8 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
